title: REM: What to Store, When to Recall, What to Forget in Experience Memory for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now autonomously complete long-horizon tasks, such as repository-level coding, through hundreds of think-act steps, yet the experience each run produces is rarely reused on the next. Prior memory systems concentrate on retrieval, finding the most relevant past trajectory. Retrieval cannot observe the running agent, so it cannot decide whether the agent needs an experience, at which point, or for how long. We introduce REM (Reusable Experience Memory), a framework that manages the memory lifecycle from inside the agent's think-act loop through three explicit decisions. What to store: each completed trajectory is consolidated into a phase-structured document, two orders of magnitude smaller than the trajectory. translated_title: REM：编码智能体经验记忆中的存储什么、何时召回、遗忘什么
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体现在能够通过数百个“思考-行动”步骤自主完成长程任务，例如仓库级编程，然而每次运行所产生的经验很少在下次运行中被复用。先前的记忆系统主要集中于检索，即寻找最相关的过往轨迹。但检索无法观察到正在运行的智能体，因此无法判断智能体是否需要某条经验、在哪个时刻需要、以及需要多长时间。我们提出了REM（可复用经验记忆，Reusable Experience Memory），这是一个从智能体“思考-行动”循环内部管理记忆生命周期的框架，通过三个显式决策实现。存储什么：每条已完成的轨迹被整合为一份阶段结构化文档，其规模比原始轨迹小两个数量级。何时召回：该文档在任务开始时注入；成本更高的实现记录则被保留，直到循环内的门控机制检测到智能体陷入困境时才注入。遗忘什么：该记录会被驱逐（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: REM框架让编码智能体在“思考-行动”循环内部自主管理经验记忆的完整生命周期，通过“存储什么、何时召回、遗忘什么”三个显式决策，实现过往经验的按需压缩、按需召回与按需遗忘。
en_tdlr: REM enables coding agents to manage the full lifecycle of experience memory from within their think-act loop through three explicit decisions—what to store, when to recall, and what to forget—allowing on-demand compression, retrieval, and disposal of past experience.
